newsitem.title: USA: Helmerich & Payne Q2 net soars on gas prices.
newsitem.headline: Helmerich & Payne Q2 net soars on gas prices.

text.p: Helmerich & Payne Inc said Thursday a surge in higher oil and natural gas prices and higher production volumes helped earnings double in the second quarter ended March 31.

The company reported net income of $22.4 million, or $0.90 a share, versus $11.0 million, or $0.45 a share, in the same period a year ago. Revenues rose to $132.5 million from $95.2 million in the second quarter last year.
Helmerich & Payne said average natural gas prices were 54 percent above last year's $1.72 average and average oil prices were up to $2.86 versus $18.24 last year.
The contract drilling and oil and gas exploration company plans to continue to focus on improved exploration results to boost production in a cost-effective manner.
Helmerich & Payne shares were up 5/8 Thursday at 47-7/8.
